name: Push Notification via ntfy
description: Send a scheduled push notification to your phone or desktop through ntfy, a free pub-sub service, with a single HTTP request and no account or app credentials to manage.

parameters.label: ntfy topic
parameters.help: The topic name to publish to. Anyone who knows a topic name can read it, so choose a long, hard-to-guess one and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. The curl tool must be installed.

parameters.label: Message
parameters.help: The notification text. Avoid double quotes in it.
